invoice.title: Invoice
invoice.heading: Invoice {number}
invoice.intro: Thank you for your order. We invoice you for the following services:
invoice.creditNoteIntro: We credit you the following amounts:
invoice.correctionIntro: This credit note corrects invoice {invoice} and cancels it in full. The invoiced services are shown again on the new invoice; no money is paid back.

notes.serviceDate: Unless stated otherwise, the date of supply is the invoice date.
notes.paid: Paid in full on {date} via {method}. Thank you!
notes.paidAdditional: Previously paid: {previous}. Additional payment: {additional} (received {date}, {method}). The invoice total of {total} is paid in full; nothing is due.
notes.paidByCredit: Previously paid: {previous} (including the overpayment of {credit}, which was credited against the tariff change). The invoice total of {total} is paid in full; nothing is due.
notes.paidAdditionalCredit: Previously paid: {previous} (including the overpayment of {credit}, which was credited against the tariff change). Additional payment: {additional} (received {date}, {method}). The invoice total of {total} is paid in full; nothing is due.
notes.overpaymentLeft: A further overpayment of {amount} remains with the order.
